html_source:
Joyce refers to these names as the “Irish heroes and heroines of antiquity,” and brings in a sort of rising absurdity. (A comedic technique referred to simply as escalation)

Beginning with Irish heroes, and Irish names (Niall of nine hostages, Shane O'Neill, Father John Murphy) he begins to escalate to names such as Ludwig Beethoven, Christopher Columbus, and even “Adam and Eve.”

This seems to be a jab at Irish nationalism.
